meta.purpose: Machine-readable cross-check results for PTCGP slot rates. Companion to review/pull_rate_cross_check.md.
meta.official_verification_note: NOT official in-app verified. Rates confirmed by 4 independent reputable third-party sources only. Official verification requires opening PTCGP app -> any pack -> Pack details -> Offering Rates.

accepted_source_criteria: Reputable gaming news or guide site
Explicitly refers to Pokemon TCG Pocket (not TCG Live or physical TCG)
rejected_source_types: Sites that copy tables without attribution

sources_evaluated.author: Jeremiah Sevilla
sources_evaluated.title: Is there a Pokemon TCG Pocket pity system? Drop rates explained
sources_evaluated.notes: All slot rates match. One typo: 1☆ slot4 printed as 2.2572% — at that value slot4 rates sum to 99.685%, not 100%. Correct value is 2.572%. Our model's 2.572% is correct.

sources_evaluated.author: Joe Pring
sources_evaluated.title: Rarest cards in Pokemon TCG Pocket & pull rates
sources_evaluated.notes: Shows per-CARD rates (not per-slot rates). Crown slot4 range 0.013%-0.040% = per_slot_rate / pool_size. Our per-slot rate of 0.040% is consistent. Fixed 3☆ rates (slot4=0.222%, slot5=0.888%) match exactly.
HTTP 403 — inaccessible at time of evaluation.
HTTP 405 — inaccessible at time of evaluation.
Shows 0.040% crown and 0.222% 3☆ (consistent with slot4 rates) but these appear to be aggregate not per-slot rates. Community-derived attribution. Not used for confirmation.
Approximate community data, not slot-specific. Does not meet acceptance criteria.

discrepancies.explanation: Typo in source. 2.2572% causes slot4 rates to sum to 99.685%, not 100.000%. At 2.572% they sum to exactly 100.000%. Our model value of 2.572% is correct.
Not a discrepancy. Dexerto shows per-card rates; range reflects pool size variation. Per-slot rate of 0.040% is consistent with all Dexerto per-card rates.

caveats: No source has explicitly confirmed these are from the official in-app Offering Rates disclosure screen.
